turns.question: For returns dated 1 or 2 October 2026, what was the median number of days between the original order date and the return date?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the days between an order and its return, nor any median of it; the closest metrics are Returns (returns_count, counted on the return date) and Returns by order date (returns_on_order_date), which count returns but not the time between order and return.

turns.question: On 1 and 2 October 2026, how much larger in EUR was the average amount of returns with reason damaged than of returns with reason wrong size?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-return-amount metric; the closest are Returns (EUR) and Returns: on 1-2 October 2026, damaged returns came to 12.50 EUR over 1 return and wrong-size returns to 5.00 EUR over 1 return. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z.

turns.question: For outreach messages sent between 20 September and 3 October 2026 that got a reply, what was the 75th percentile of hours between the message and the reply?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for the time between an outreach message and its reply, nor any percentile of it; the closest metrics are Messages replied (messages_replied), Replies (replies) and Reply rate (reply_rate).
